[archetype] Imagine a workshop owner with an order book and a machine loan coming due. [stakes] The renewal quote takes money from the next hire. [promise] Stay for the checks that reveal where the pressure lands. [rehook] The owner cannot wait forever for cheaper borrowing. The lender can earn a high Treasury yield without taking the workshop's risk. [new] The deadline turns a market price into a business decision. [loop] The owner postpones the machine and the supplier loses the order. [payoff] That is how a balance-sheet decision reaches a worker and a customer.
